headline: Rich valuation, still strong Buy consensus
chart_note: 52-week range: $98.88 - $135.16. Currently $107.15, about 21% below its high.
why_today: Walmart trades about 21% below its 52-week high despite an otherwise steady Buy consensus, as investors weigh its rich 38.8x PE against a resilient but slower-growing retail business.
pro_1: 37 of 38 analysts rate it Buy, average price target of $127 implies nearly 19% upside
pro_2: E-commerce and advertising growth continue diversifying revenue beyond traditional retail margins
con_1: PE of 38.8x is unusually rich for a grocery-heavy retailer - priced more like a growth stock
con_2: 21% pullback from its 52-week high suggests the market has real questions about that premium
